seo.title: DevLeadHunter — Sell Apple Wallet loyalty cards to local businesses
seo.description: The DevLeadHunter loyalty module: a stamp card customers add to Apple Wallet in one scan, offers pushed to their lock screen, a merchant dashboard in the shop's own brand — and a recurring subscription you collect every month.

hero.subtitle: A stamp card that lands in Apple Wallet in one scan, and offers that show up on the lock screen. You set it up, the merchant runs it — and you collect every month.

story.title: Follow one card, from the counter to the lock screen.
story.subtitle: From the QR next to the till to the offer that brings the customer back, everything chains together. Here is the full journey.

act1.description: Set up the program in two minutes: logo, colors, number of stamps, reward. The card is ready and the merchant receives their access.

act2.description: The customer scans the QR on the counter. Their card lands in Apple Wallet in two seconds — no app, no form.

act3.description: On every visit, the merchant stamps with one click. On the last stamp, the reward unlocks right on the card.

act4.description: An offer goes out to every card — or ten minutes after a checkout. It shows up on the lock screen, and the customer comes back.

visual.notifBody: Your Thursday offer is here: -10% off your next coffee.

notifications.title: The channel nobody can ignore.
notifications.description: Not an email lost in the promotions tab, not yet another SMS: the offer shows up on the lock screen, next to train tickets and boarding passes. That is the real value of the card.
notifications.bullet1: Automation: a checkout triggers the offer a few minutes later
notifications.bullet2: Broadcast to the shop's whole customer base in one click
notifications.bullet3: No phone number or email address needed: the card is enough
notifications.bullet4: Consent collected when the card is added, GDPR compliant

features.title: A machine that brings customers back.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.q1: Who should I sell this module to?
faq.a1: High-frequency local businesses: cafés, barbers, kebab shops, bakeries, beauty salons… Anywhere customers come back every week, a loyalty card in the phone makes the difference.
faq.q2: Do the shop's customers need to install an app?
faq.a2: No. Apple Wallet is preinstalled on every iPhone: the customer scans the counter QR, taps “Add”, and that's it.
faq.a3: The module covers Apple Wallet today. Google Wallet support is planned — same card, same dashboard, one more channel.
faq.q4: How does the merchant stamp a card?
faq.a4: From their space, with one click on the customer's row. No hardware to buy, no till to change.
faq.a5: Yes. Consent is collected when the customer adds their card, and removing the card from their Wallet stops everything — no superfluous data is collected.
faq.q6: How much does it cost, and who pays what?
faq.a6: The merchant pays €19 a month, first month free, no commitment. Collection is automatic via Stripe.
